description: The last build somebody recorded, so that a change to the pipeline shows up as a diff in this file rather than as a number in a terminal nobody kept. `measures` is every counter the assessment collects; `expectations` is the status each expectation had. Rewrite it with `brightway-flows assess --record` after a full build, and never after a `--max-flows` run: a bounded run measures a prefix of the base list and would record every count as collapsed. Nothing here gates anything -- a measure that moves is reported, and whether the movement was right is what the expectations say.
